description: This file defines an interface in Java for building responses and events related to the 'ModifyFeatureProperties' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory interfaces for creating command responses (e.g., created, modified, error responses) and event objects (e.g., feature created, feature modified) that are used in the live command processing framework.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for creating command responses and events related to modifying feature properties in a live command context.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Builds a 'created' response for a ModifyFeatureProperties command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Builds a 'modified' response for a ModifyFeatureProperties command.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating feature properties are not accessible.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotModifiableError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating feature properties are not modifiable.
